glosses: to aggregate (to connect elements into a whole)

examples.text: Podkreślić należy, że operujemy tu zagregowanym pojęciem popytu i podaży.
examples.translation: It has to be underlined, that here we are operating on an aggregated sense of supply and demand.
examples.english: It has to be underlined, that here we are operating on an aggregated sense of supply and demand.
